name: xpipe
description: HTTPS download, zero hash/sig, then runs the installer with sudo/msiexec/rpm --force (--force explicitly bypasses signature checks).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports the narrow recorded behavior: xpipe writes downloaded installer bytes directly and invokes platform installers without in-app hash or signature verification.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or independent release signing.
